description: UK national open data portal is an open data portal listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.gov.uk. data.gov.uk is the UK national open data portal. This harvest searched it with about 40 infrastructure phrases and read 5,184 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water or digital network, asset or facility are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, survey tables, environment, marine science, planning, culture and ... Coverage: United Kingdom. 5,184 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 695 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
